decisions.decision: Предпочесть statistics.mean за narrow common finite-binary64 wrapper; midpoint через mean двух чисел. Не менять provenance policy.
decisions.reason: CPython mean уже группирует exact integer ratios по denominator, суммирует рационально и округляет после total/n. fmean и even median не дают нужной overflow/subnormal семантики. Нужен finite/type wrapper, а не смешанные Decimal/NumPy types.
decisions.cost_and_tradeoffs: O(n) conversion, bounded binary64 denominator buckets; big integers растут с log n. Не бесплатно и не vectorized. Большой group-cost измерить; optimized fallback только при доказанном сохранении точности.
decisions.validation: Target3.14 independent Fraction oracle: extremes, signed cancellation, subnormal ties, permutations, empty/singleton, n scaling. FED sole writer; UQS contract tests.

decisions.decision: Сохранить Arrow streaming + existing snapshot owner; DuckDB/Arrow handoff оптимизировать только после профиля.
alternatives: Arrow RecordBatchReader→DuckDB вместо per-batch pandas conversion
decisions.reason: iter_batches и column projection решают bounded reading; file-like input позволяет читать captured snapshot. DuckDB читает Arrow reader и умеет pushdown, но сам не заменяет source capture/retry/row ordinal contract.
decisions.cost_and_tradeoffs: Нынешний capture: O(file bytes) disk+hash/copy и O(batch) dataframe; fallback повторно сканирует prefix. Direct scan может сократить copies, но обязан сохранить immutable basis и exactly accepted prefix.
decisions.validation: Batch1/odd sizes/rowgroup changes, duplicate-valued distinct rows, failure afteryield, same-stat ABA mutation, tmp free space/peak RSS/read bytes. Нет утверждения zero-copy во всём пути.

decisions.decision: Сохранить hnswlib; добавить exact small-corpus oracle и measured quality/cost qualification.
decisions.locked_baseline: hnswlib0.8.0 optional vector-search; lock entry sdist without wheels; NumPy available.
alternatives: NumPy exact cosine/flat retrieval для small N
decisions.reason: Native index admission принадлежит existing shared owner. HNSW set_ef после load важен и уже есть=100; stored-vector equality не доказывает retrieval recall. FAISS предлагает exact baseline/quantization, но migration сейчас не оправдана.
decisions.cost_and_tradeoffs: HNSW строится и держит graph memory. При редких query exact scan может быть проще; warm validation читает whole artifacts/text. Сначала measurements, затем bounded immutable-generation lease, не stat-only cache.
decisions.validation: Cold/warm query at N ladder, exact cosine no-tie fixtures, recall@k on frozen query holdout, provenance and withdrawal; native build availability3.14 qualification before stronger claim.

decisions.locked_baseline: sentence-transformers2.7.0 rag-local; torch2.10.0; transformers4.57.6; research/all extra не включает rag-local.
decisions.reason: 2.7 constructor supports local path/revision/device; owner уже snapshot_download(local_files_only=True), exact assets и dimension. Generic text encoder полезен candidate, не заменяет owned served witness.
decisions.cost_and_tradeoffs: Tiny corpus не делает саму модель tiny. Отдельно cold load/RSS, encode batches, runtime hashing. Tokenizer truncation может скрыть релевантный конец текста; обязательна adversarial retrieval qualification, не обещание всех языков.
decisions.validation: Заранее предоставленные local assets; actual model+index+fresh public query, no admission mock; second content corpus with frozen holdout. No downloads/install authorized.

decisions.decision: Сохранить domain stream/frontier и stdlib asyncio/deque/locks; не переносить в Flink/Kafka ради локального ремонта.
decisions.locked_baseline: Python3.14 asyncio, aiohttp3.13.3; existing CAS/cursor/pool/rate limiter.
decisions.reason: Shield не делает independently-cancelled task живой: terminal state обязан settle. Operator byte budget — не eviction cache; live keys нельзя выбрасывать ради capacity. Callback success belongs completed provider outcome, not attempted request.
decisions.cost_and_tradeoffs: O(1) byte counter не устраняет O(buffer) _prune_row_refs/preview copies. Explicit process resources remain until physical close; cancellation deadline not FD evidence.
decisions.validation: Barrier-driven cancellation, watchdog+heartbeat, os.fstat/pread and fresh session, independent row/window oracle, UTC restart. Custom limiter local, no distributed quota claim.

decisions.decision: Сохранить общий pinned raw transport; stdlib absolute async deadline в существующем owner.
decisions.locked_baseline: urllib custom raw owner; HTTPX0.28.1 already used in search adapters; common bounded executor.
decisions.reason: HTTPX timeouts не total deadline. Custom transports дают extension seam, но не автоматически peer/SNI/redirect policy. Offline saved-byte admission отделить от live DNS. Shared raw owner already implemented; переписывание добавит риск.
decisions.cost_and_tradeoffs: Outer cancellation прекращает ожидание, не гарантирует уничтожение running blocking thread. Current shared executor сохраняет physical slot; измерять exit/resource separately. DNS before cache запрещает offline reuse.
decisions.validation: Persisted offline cache network0, real local TLS/SNI redirects on allowed fixture, drip response vs absolute budget, all failover attempt starts. Не ослаблять rawbytes/MIME/maxbytes.

decisions.decision: Оставить OTel и узкий best-effort optional boundary; mandatory budget/audit вне неё.
decisions.locked_baseline: OTel API/SDK1.39.1 core; declared no-OTel fallback distinct environment.
decisions.reason: OTel principle предпочитает потерю telemetry изменению business logic; injection useful even if normal SDK handles exporter errors. Existing _post_record mutates mandatory projection; optional tail isolate only.
decisions.cost_and_tradeoffs: Safe callbacks add small overhead; не создавать recursive diagnostic failure. Fallback profile не равен ordinary core install with OTel; проверить ABI independently.
decisions.validation: Enter/exit/attribute/status fault matrix, body exception cannot be suppressed, response/ledger persist, provider count1, unknown owner blocks spend then recovers.

decisions.decision: Сохранить domain content-bound owners; cachetools/TTL лишь storage primitive, не permission/proof/single-flight framework.
decisions.locked_baseline: cachetools6.2.4 existing; custom PromptCache owns proofs/settlement and shared Future state.
decisions.reason: TTL/memoization не кодирует current actor/epoch/selected CAS/profile/prepared wire bytes. Frozen six-role translator closure минимальна и переносима на данные, а произвольные live/tool requests остаются physical-only.
decisions.cost_and_tradeoffs: Public docs newer than lock used only generic comparison. Extra binding adds hashes+CAS reads, но решает semantic ownership; per-key revision optimization не нужна для one-retry correction.
decisions.validation: Two actual translator bundles, one-role mutation matrix, explicit optional absence, no stale grant, separate loops/follower cancellation, physical ledger readback. Exact response-content holdout prevents constant fixture becoming semantic proof.
